name: 未来学习中心

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. A compact futuristic learning center: orderly rectangular window grid, cream-gray wall panels, broad ground entrance, electronic course-board housing with blank screen, small stepped roof and cyan trim. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately
